status.birth_data_changed: The client's birth details changed after this analysis; the analysis was prepared with the details saved at that time.
status.source_chart_deleted: The source individual analysis was later deleted or changed; this result is a historical record.
status.client_deleted: The client profile was later deleted; the name is shown from the historical record.

image.missing: The image could not be created for this report.
image.resultOnlyNote: Because the source individual analysis data is no longer available, the chart shows only the channels completed together in the saved result; half channels are not drawn.

legend.standard1: Standard Human Design combined BodyGraph. Colour shows the person: blue = A, orange = B; a two-coloured (half-and-half) gate = active in both people.
legend.standard2: The chart draws only the channels the two people complete TOGETHER. Two-coloured channel = Electromagnetic; single-coloured channel = Dominance, Compromise or Companionship (type in the table below).
legend.standard3: Coloured center = defined in the combined chart; white center = open. Half channels and all active gates of each person are in the 'Half Channels and Active Gates' section.
legend.connection1: Colour shows the person: blue = A, orange = B. An active gate colours its own half of the channel in the person's colour; an orange-striped half on a blue base and a two-coloured gate = a gate shared by both people.
legend.connection2: Channel with both halves coloured = defined in the combined chart. Channel with only one half coloured = half channel (not defined). The connection type is in the channel table below.
legend.connection3: Coloured center = defined in the combined chart; white center = open.
legend.schematic1: Colour shows the person: blue = A, orange = B; two-coloured (striped / half circle) = a gate shared by both people.
legend.schematic2: Thick channel = defined in the combined chart. Thin dashed half channel = only one gate active (not defined).
legend.schematic3: The shape in the middle of a channel shows the connection type: ◆ Electromagnetic · ▲ Dominance · ■ Compromise · ● Companionship.
legend.schematic4: Filled center = defined in the combined chart; A / B / A+B in the center = the person who defines the center in their own chart.
legend.penta1: Thick purple line = Penta channel defined in the group (strength); pink = 2/14 core defined; dotted grey = gap (channel not completed).
legend.penta2: Numbered badges next to a gate show the members carrying that gate (number = member order); dashed gate + 'gap' = no member carries it.

conn.noChannels: The two people do not complete any channel together.
conn.centersNote: In the combined chart a channel counts as defined when the two people together carry both of its gates. The last column shows who defines the center in their OWN chart.

gates.heading: Half Channels and Active Gates
gates.noSource: Half channels and all active gates of each person cannot be shown because the source individual analysis data is not included in this report.
gates.halfNote: Half channel: only one gate of the channel is active together; it is not defined in the combined chart.
gates.allHeading: All active gates of each person
gates.starNote: * Gate belonging to a channel completed together.
